title: Measuring Agent Self-Knowledge Under a Criterion Held Out of the Environment (MRF-2026-02 reproducibility data)
description: Reproducibility data for Montana Research Foundation preprint MRF-2026-02, "Measuring Agent Self-Knowledge Under a Criterion Held Out of the Environment": per-rollout aggregate records and a self-contained verify.py that recomputes the paper's headline from the records alone. Task families, raw agent transcripts, and held-out grading data are withheld under contamination control.
notes: Deposit this experiment as its own Zenodo record. Once the preprint is posted, add its DOI as an isSupplementTo related identifier. Send to the Zenodo API wrapped as {"metadata": <this object>}.
